expo.name: Thingual
expo.description: Learn languages from the things around you: point your camera, learn the word in 16 languages, practise phrases and share photos on a world map.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Thingual uses the camera to recognise objects and show their names in the language you learn.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose a photo to learn the words in it.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your posts show only your city, never the exact place.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Thingual listens when you practise pronunciation or talk to the AI partner.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Speech recognition checks your pronunciation and turns your voice into text in conversation practice.
